item.title: QShare - Privacy SaaS
item.description:
Project Overview

QShare is a modern, privacy-centric file-sharing solution built for users who prioritize data security. Traditional sharing platforms often leave temporary files on servers indefinitely, posing a long-term privacy risk. QShare solves this with a built-in auto-purge engine, ensuring your files exist only for the duration you intend.

Key Highlights

  • Automated Self-Destruction: Powered by Supabase Edge Functions, the system runs a background purge engine that scans and permanently deletes expired files every 5 minutes.
  • Seamless QR Integration: Features instant QR code generation to facilitate rapid, contactless file transfers between mobile and desktop devices.
  • Zero-Footprint Environment: By automatically scrubbing expired assets, the platform maintains a clean server environment and ensures no residual data is left behind.
  • Enterprise-Grade Security: Utilizes Supabase Auth and Row Level Security (RLS) to ensure that data is only accessible to authorized recipients during the sharing window.

Technical Deep Dive

  • Frontend: Built with Next.js (Server Components) for high-performance rendering and SEO optimization.
  • Backend & Infrastructure: Leverages the Supabase ecosystem for real-time database management and secure cloud storage.
  • Serverless Logic: Employs Deno-based Edge Functions to handle the core purge logic without the need for a dedicated, always-on backend server.
  • Design: Crafted with a sleek, minimalistic dark-themed UI using Tailwind CSS.

Use Cases

  • Sensitive Documents: Safely sharing temporary files like National IDs, resumes, or private photos.
  • Quick Cross-Device Transfer: Moving files between a mobile phone and a public PC without the need for logging into email or social media.
  • Draft Deliverables: Freelancers sharing time-sensitive drafts that should expire automatically after client review.

Workflow

  1. Upload: User uploads a file and sets a custom expiration timer.
  2. Generate: The system creates a unique, secure URL and a corresponding QR code.
  3. Purge: Once the timer hits zero, the Edge Function triggers an automated deletion, removing the file from both the database and physical storage.

item.title: CalcHubBD - Pro Suite
item.description:
Project Overview

CalcHubBD is an all-in-one calculation platform housing over 60 essential tools for both daily life and professional workflows. The platform is uniquely engineered to align with localized Bangladeshi standards, such as specific taxation rules and regional unit conversions, making it a highly relevant tool for the local market.

Core Features

  • 60+ Specialized Tools:
    • Financial: Advanced Loan EMI calculators, FD/RD return estimators, and localized VAT/Tax calculation engines.
    • Health & Wellness: Tools for tracking BMI, BMR, and daily water intake requirements.
    • Academic: Precise GPA/CGPA calculators and comprehensive unit conversion tools.
    • Business Logic: Professional tools for calculating profit margins, markups, and inventory metrics.
  • Localized Calculation Logic: Beyond global standards, the platform integrates regional currency formats and specific taxation laws applicable in Bangladesh.
  • Smart Global Search: Features an instant-discovery search system to help users find specific tools without navigating through complex menus.
  • Responsive Architecture: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS to ensure a seamless, high-performance experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: Next.js (App Router) for optimized server-side rendering and high performance.
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS for a modern, utility-first design approach.
  • Deployment: Hosted on Vercel, optimized for lightning-fast loading speeds and global availability.

Why I Built This

Daily tasks often require switching between multiple apps or websites for simple calculations—whether it’s checking a bank loan EMI or a student calculating their GPA. CalcHubBD was created to eliminate this friction by consolidating all these essential tools into a single, high-speed, and reliable platform.

item.title: ShopMaster SaaS
item.description:
Project Overview

ShopMaster SaaS is a high-performance, web-based inventory management system designed specifically for independent retail business owners and small enterprises. Built with a focus on speed, scalability, and usability, it offers a secure multi-tenant environment where every business can manage its operations independently.

Core Business Logic

  • Multi-Tenant Architecture: Engineered with secure private data silos, ensuring that each shop’s data remains strictly isolated. Every business owner gets a personalized dashboard and configuration settings.
  • Real-time Business Intelligence: The dashboard provides instant insights into total revenue, inventory volume, and detailed sales logs, enabling owners to make data-driven decisions quickly.
  • Smart Billing & Stock Sync: Features an automated transaction engine that deducts stock levels in real-time upon every sale and triggers low-stock alerts to prevent inventory shortages.
  • Professional Invoicing: Automatically generates sleek, professional PDF invoices immediately after a transaction is completed.

Technical Implementation

  • Backend: Leveraged PHP 8.x to handle complex business logic with optimized performance.
  • Database: Utilized MySQL for relational data integrity, handling multi-tenant queries through efficient indexing.
  • Frontend: Implemented JavaScript ES6 for dynamic inventory updates and an interactive, responsive user experience.
  • Security: Prioritized data safety with robust protection against SQL Injection, XSS, and secure session management.

Why This Project Matters

ShopMaster is more than just a tool; it is a comprehensive business solution. The implementation of multi-tenancy transforms it into a true Software as a Service (SaaS) model, demonstrating a high level of technical architecture capable of scaling to support thousands of users.
